items.title: Northline Retail Group files chapter 11 in Delaware with $1.4bn of funded debt
items.snippet: Petition lists 340 leases and a $210m first-day DIP request; first-day hearing set for Thursday.

items.title: Judge approves $875m DIP for Cascade Energy Partners over committee objection
items.snippet: Order includes a 1.5:1 roll-up and a 120-day milestone to file a plan.

items.title: Ad hoc lender group signs cooperation agreement covering 68% of Meridian term loan
items.snippet: Signatories agree not to participate in any non-pro-rata transaction for 180 days.

items.title: Confirmation hearing set for December after disclosure statement approved
items.snippet: Court declined to schedule a separate valuation trial, citing DIP budget constraints.

items.title: Harbour Media completes distressed exchange at 62 cents on the dollar
items.snippet: Participation reached 91%; the stub 2027 notes remain outstanding at the holdco.

items.title: Stalking horse bid of $310m set for chapter 11 363 auction next month
items.snippet: Break-up fee of 3% approved; competing bids due two weeks before the auction date.
